item.Ignis.name: Ignis
item.Ignis.desc: The Prime of fire: heat, change, appetite.
item.Aqua.name: Aqua
item.Aqua.desc: The Prime of water: flow, solution, life.
item.Terra.name: Terra
item.Terra.desc: The Prime of earth: weight, body, patience.
item.Aer.name: Aer
item.Aer.desc: The Prime of air: breath, lightness, scent.
item.Sal.name: Sal
item.Sal.desc: The Principle of salt: what stays, fixes and preserves.
item.Sulphur.name: Sulphur
item.Sulphur.desc: The Principle of sulphur: what burns, colours and binds.
item.Mercurius.name: Mercurius
item.Mercurius.desc: The Principle of mercury: what moves, joins and quickens.
item.Aether.name: Aether
item.Aether.desc: The fifth essence. Rare, and found only in rare things.
condition.Flowers.hint: Something here likes the smell of flowers.
condition.Darkness.hint: This wants to rot where no light reaches: a Lab alcove, the Undercroft, a cave.
condition.PowerVapor.hint: Something here needs steam from a Boiler beside it.
condition.PowerFulgur.hint: Something here needs a charged Lightning Coil beside it.
condition.PowerFlamma.hint: Only a kindled Athanor's own fire will do.
condition.Monday.hint: Silver grows on the Moon's day.
condition.SunOrMoonDay.hint: The Sun and the Moon wed only on their own days.
condition.Night.hint: Some things are only done under the stars.
condition.LabHearth.hint: A hearth's warmth helps a calcination along.
condition.Shades.hint: Carry a Gloam Lantern with a Shade in it.
apparatus.ExperimentTable.name: Experiment Table
apparatus.ExperimentTable.desc: Try any two things together. Nothing is wasted that teaches you something.
apparatus.Athanor.name: Athanor
apparatus.Athanor.desc: A slow furnace. Takes things apart into their Primes. Feed it Ignis and Ignis to kindle it.
apparatus.Alembic.name: Alembic
apparatus.Alembic.desc: Dissolves when cold. Beside a kindled Athanor or a Boiler, it distills.
apparatus.Retort.name: Retort
apparatus.Retort.desc: Separates and coagulates. Flowers nearby improve its work.
apparatus.HermeticVessel.name: Hermetic Vessel
apparatus.HermeticVessel.desc: The sealed egg: joins things in the light, and rots them in the dark.
apparatus.Calcinator.name: Calcinator
apparatus.Calcinator.desc: A coal-fired furnace. Fast decomposition, with more residue. Burns Coal or Bitumen.
apparatus.ProcessVat.name: Process Vat
apparatus.ProcessVat.desc: Tobin's vessel. Dissolves and ferments; beside a Boiler it distills, beside a Lightning Coil it separates. Both at once: nothing.
apparatus.Press.name: Press
apparatus.Press.desc: Alloys and moulds. Joins and sets things, in bulk.
apparatus.Boiler.name: Boiler
apparatus.Boiler.desc: Feed it Ignis and Aqua: it steams for most of a day, powering and heating up to four neighbours.
apparatus.LightningCoil.name: Lightning Coil
apparatus.LightningCoil.desc: Stores Fulgur as charges. Storms charge it for free. Feed it Ignis and Aer.
apparatus.Pelican.name: Pelican
apparatus.Pelican.desc: Bennet's glass. Circulates a substance with Sal Fixum, raising its quality, up to gold.
apparatus.RitualAltar.name: Ritual Altar
apparatus.RitualAltar.desc: Stage a rite on it, then click it with an empty hand to perform it. Ritual quality goes up to iridium.
apparatus.QuarryCrucible.name: Quarry Crucible
apparatus.QuarryCrucible.desc: Agnes's crucible. Grows the planetary metals on their days; beside a Lightning Coil, Orichalcum.
apparatus.LeyTap.name: Ley Tap
apparatus.LeyTap.desc: Placed on a ley node, it draws that node's Primes each morning.
apparatus.RitualCircle.name: Ritual Circle
item.FlammaViva.name: Flamma Viva
item.FlammaViva.desc: Living flame. Fed to an Athanor, it kindles it for good.
item.RosMaialis.name: Ros Maialis
item.RosMaialis.desc: May dew, distilled. Drink it and your watering can goes further.
item.Saxum.name: Saxum
item.Saxum.desc: Worked stone, dense and true. Builders like it.
item.Pneuma.name: Pneuma
item.SalFixum.name: Sal Fixum
item.SalFixum.desc: Fixed salt. It does not move, and keeps what it touches.
item.SulphurVivum.name: Sulphur Vivum
item.MercuriusCurrens.name: Mercurius Currens
item.MercuriusCurrens.desc: Running mercury. Hard to keep in one place.
item.QuintaEssentia.name: Quinta Essentia
item.QuintaEssentia.desc: The quintessence. Nobody is sure what it is for yet.
item.Vapor.name: Vapor
item.Vapor.desc: Steam: the strength of a Boiler.
item.Magma.name: Magma
item.Magma.desc: Molten earth, cooled just enough to carry.
item.Fulgur.name: Fulgur
item.Fulgur.desc: Lightning: the strength of a Coil.
item.Limus.name: Limus
item.Limus.desc: Primordial mud. Things grow in it.
item.Tempestas.name: Tempestas
item.Tempestas.desc: A storm in a flask. Keep the stopper in.
item.Pulvis.name: Pulvis
item.Pulvis.desc: Fine dust, calcined. The start of glass.
item.Calx.name: Calx
item.Calx.desc: Burnt lime, white and dry. Sells, and makes glass.
item.Quebrith.name: Quebrith
item.Phlogiston.name: Phlogiston
item.Phlogiston.desc: The stuff that leaves a thing when it burns, they say.
item.SalMarinum.name: Sal Marinum
item.AquaFortis.name: Aqua Fortis
item.Hydragenum.name: Hydragenum
item.Vitreus.name: Vitreus
item.Bitumen.name: Bitumen
item.Bitumen.desc: Pitch. It burns slowly and seals well.
item.Metallum.name: Metallum
item.SalVolatile.name: Sal Volatile
item.SalVolatile.desc: Smelling salts. A quick, small lift of energy.
item.Miasma.name: Miasma
item.Miasma.desc: Bad air, bottled before it can spread.
item.Motus.name: Motus
item.Motus.desc: Motion itself, distilled to a few drops.
item.Sol.name: Sol
item.Luna.name: Luna
item.Vitae.name: Vitae
item.Vitae.desc: The spark of life, bound to earth.
item.Spiritus.name: Spiritus
item.Spiritus.desc: Spirit. It rises if you let it.
item.Vitriol.name: Vitriol
item.Vitriol.desc: Green vitriol. Visit the interior of the earth.
item.MercuriusFixus.name: Mercurius Fixus
item.Cinnabaris.name: Cinnabaris
item.Cinnabaris.desc: Cinnabar, the red of the old dyers.
item.Ordo.name: Ordo
item.Ordo.desc: Order. It holds other things in place.
item.Anima.name: Anima
item.Anima.desc: Soul, or something close to it.
item.MercuriusPhilosophorum.name: Mercurius Philosophorum
item.MercuriusPhilosophorum.desc: The philosophers' mercury. Its use is not yet known.
item.CaputMortuum.name: Caput Mortuum
item.CaputMortuum.desc: The dead head: what is left. A weak fertilizer, and the start of better things.
item.Vitrum.name: Vitrum
item.Vitrum.desc: Clear glass. Sells well, and the Lab is built with it.
item.TerraViva.name: Terra Viva
item.TerraViva.desc: Living earth. Spread it on tilled soil for better crops.
item.Vigor.name: Vigor
item.Vigor.desc: A strong tonic. A large lift of energy.
item.Smaltum.name: Smaltum
item.Smaltum.desc: Cobalt-blue glass, ground fine. A strong blue dye.
item.PulvisPyrius.name: Pulvis Pyrius
item.PulvisPyrius.desc: Black powder. Teaches the Bomb and Mega Bomb recipes.
item.AquaRegia.name: Aqua Regia
item.AquaRegia.desc: Royal water. It dissolves even gold.
item.AquaVitae.name: Aqua Vitae
item.AquaVitae.desc: Water of life. A spirit that makes friends of strangers.
item.Electrum.name: Electrum
item.Electrum.desc: Gold and silver, smelted together. A reliable alloy.
item.Rebis.name: Rebis
item.Rebis.desc: The double thing: Sun and Moon wed in one body.
item.Orichalcum.name: Orichalcum
item.Orichalcum.desc: The lost metal of the old stories, grown with lightning.
item.Elixir.name: Elixir
item.Elixir.desc: A healing draught. Health returns slowly while it lasts.
item.Panacea.name: Panacea
item.Panacea.desc: The cure for all ills: clears every debuff.
item.CinisPhoenicis.name: Cinis Phoenicis
item.CinisPhoenicis.desc: Phoenix ash. Rub it on, and the next fall doesn't finish you.
item.Gelum.name: Gelum
item.Gelum.desc: Frost in a jar. Feed it to a cow in winter.
item.Venenum.name: Venenum
item.Venenum.desc: Poison for blades. Apply it before a fight.
item.Ectoplasm.name: Ectoplasm
item.Ectoplasm.desc: Ghost-stuff. The Curator has uses for it.
item.PerpetuumMobile.name: Perpetuum Mobile
item.PerpetuumMobile.desc: The engine that never stops. It needs an altar with a Boiler beside it.
item.Radicula.name: Radicula
item.Radicula.desc: A rootling: a little plant spirit. Place it in your fields; it shrieks at monsters.
item.Argentum.name: Argentum
item.Argentum.desc: Silver, grown from the metal seed on the Moon's day.
item.Stannum.name: Stannum
item.Plumbum.name: Plumbum
item.RosaVitrea.name: Rosa Vitrea
item.RosaVitrea.desc: A glass rose. A gift most people like.
item.MelVitae.name: Mel Vitae
item.MelVitae.desc: Living honey. Sweet, and a little lucky.
item.PhialaStellarum.name: Phiala Stellarum
item.PhialaStellarum.desc: A phial of starlight, sealed at night. Stargazers love it.
item.Tenebrae.name: Tenebrae
item.Tenebrae.desc: Void, the Sun's shadow. Feed it to a hen and she may lay a Void Egg.
item.Mors.name: Mors
item.Mors.desc: Death, bottled. Sprinkle it on weeds, and they wither.
item.Perditio.name: Perditio
item.Perditio.desc: Entropy. It unmakes order, and leaves the first matter behind.
item.PrimaMateria.name: Prima Materia
item.PrimaMateria.desc: The first matter, found in the dung heap after all.
item.Alkahest.name: Alkahest
item.Alkahest.desc: The universal solvent. Stone and wood fall apart at a touch.
item.Azoth.name: Azoth
item.Azoth.desc: The universal agent. Machines near an Azoth Diffuser hurry.
item.LapisPhilosophorum.name: Lapis Philosophorum
item.LapisPhilosophorum.desc: The Stone. It promises everything, and gives a little more than nothing.
hint.recipe.AdvancePelican: Circulate any substance with SalFixum in the Pelican, and it comes back finer.
hint.recipe.AdvanceAltar: Circulate any substance with MercuriusFixus in the RitualAltar, and it comes back finer.
item.AurumPotabile.name: Aurum Potabile
item.AurumPotabile.desc: Drinkable gold. The old masters swore by it, and went broke making it.
item.LacVirginis.name: Lac Virginis
item.LacVirginis.desc: Virgin's milk: the white water that whitens. A secret of this farm alone.
item.SanguisDraconis.name: Sanguis Draconis
item.SanguisDraconis.desc: Dragon's blood, red and slow. Few farms ever see it.

item.Satchel.name: Reagent Satchel
item.Satchel.desc: Holds reagents in its own pages. Primes and inputs you pick up go straight in. Click an apparatus while holding it to load a recipe.
item.Lens.name: Assayer's Lens
item.Lens.desc: Hold it and click an item, a chest or a machine to see what it is made of.
item.GloamLantern.name: Gloam Lantern
item.GloamLantern.desc: Holds Shades: one fills it each night you sleep with it. Some dark rites burn a Shade for a better result.
item.VialPendant.name: Vial Pendant
item.VialPendant.desc: A trinket. Below a quarter of your health, it drinks an Elixir from your pack for you.
item.SmoulderingCenser.name: Smouldering Censer
item.SmoulderingCenser.desc: A trinket. Burns monsters near you and gives off light.
item.RebisAmulet.name: Rebis Amulet
item.RebisAmulet.desc: A trinket. By day you hit harder; by night you take less.
item.PlanetaryBand.name: Planetary Band
item.PlanetaryBand.desc: A ring of cheap metals. Each day's planet lends a small gift.
item.RingOfTheSeven.name: Ring of the Seven
item.RingOfTheSeven.desc: Seven metals and the fifth essence. Each day's planet lends a great gift.
item.OuroborosRing.name: Ouroboros Ring
item.OuroborosRing.desc: The snake that eats its tail. Kills restore energy; your trash comes back as residue.
item.BrimstoneEgg.name: Brimstone Egg
item.BrimstoneEgg.desc: A warm, yellow egg that smells of struck matches. Rich in Sulphur.
item.GoldenFleece.name: Golden Fleece
item.GoldenFleece.desc: Wool spun through with gold. Rare, and beautiful.
item.CurioSyntheticVial.name: Synthetic Essence Vial
item.CurioSyntheticVial.desc: Joja Labs, batch 7. The label promises "Essence of Spring, 100% synthetic".
item.CurioRedactedNotebook.name: Redacted Notebook
item.CurioRedactedNotebook.desc: Most of every page is blacked out. One margin note survives: "It won't scale."
item.CurioBrokenAssay.name: Broken Assay Scale
item.CurioBrokenAssay.desc: Dr. Sorenson's first instrument. She kept it after they let her go.
item.CurioJojaBadge.name: Lab Badge
item.CurioJojaBadge.desc: A Joja Labs access badge. The photo has been scratched out.
item.CurioCrystalSeed.name: Grown Crystal
item.CurioCrystalSeed.desc: Sorenson's one success at Joja, grown in a jar on her desk.
apparatus.AzothDiffuser.name: Azoth Diffuser
apparatus.AzothDiffuser.desc: Placed, it makes every machine within 7 tiles work 25% faster for 7 days, then crumbles to residue.
apparatus.RadiculaPlant.name: Radicula
apparatus.RadiculaPlant.desc: A rootling, planted. Now and then it shrieks, stunning monsters nearby.
furniture.CircleSigil.name: Circle Sigil
furniture.CircleSigil.desc: Lay it under a Ritual Altar to make a Ritual Circle: one big rite at a time.
furniture.GlazedUrn.name: Glazed Urn
furniture.GlazedPlanter.name: Glazed Planter
furniture.GlazedTileRug.name: Glazed Tile Rug
furniture.GlazedTileRug.desc: Blue tiles laid in a square.
effect.UndinesGift.name: Undine's Gift
effect.UndinesGift.desc: Half of your waterings use no water.
effect.Fixative.name: Fixative
effect.Fixative.desc: Your food and drink buffs stop running down for a while.
effect.FixativeStrong.name: Fixative
effect.FixativeStrong.desc: Your food and drink buffs stop running down, and debuffs wear off twice as fast.
effect.Volatile.name: Volatile
effect.Volatile.desc: Your other buffs grow stronger, and shorter.
effect.LunarDream.name: Lunar Dream
effect.LunarDream.desc: Sleep tonight and dream of an undiscovered recipe.
effect.Savour.name: Savour
effect.GoodCheer.name: Good Cheer
effect.GoodCheer.desc: Friendship comes a little easier, and you never get tipsy.
effect.Vitality.name: Vitality
effect.Cleanse.name: Cleanse
effect.Cleanse.desc: Clears your debuffs, and keeps you a little more immune.
effect.Glow.name: Glow
effect.Tailwind.name: Tailwind
effect.Kindled.name: Kindled
effect.Kindled.desc: Some of your hits set monsters burning.
effect.Stonesense.name: Stonesense
effect.Stonesense.desc: Stones sometimes give an extra ore.
effect.Eruption.name: Eruption
effect.Eruption.desc: A broken stone may burst and break the stones around it.
effect.Quintessence.name: Quintessence
effect.Quintessence.desc: Your other alchemical effects are a little stronger.
effect.Midas.name: Midas Draught
effect.Midas.desc: Mined ore sometimes comes out one metal higher.
effect.Hourglass.name: Hourglass of Mercury
effect.Hourglass.desc: The clock runs slower. Single player only.
effect.Spectral.name: Spectral
effect.Spectral.desc: After a hit, nothing can touch you for a moment.
effect.Dissolution.name: Dissolution
effect.Dissolution.desc: Stones, wood and weeds break in one hit.
effect.SecondWind.name: Second Wind
effect.SecondWind.desc: The next time you'd pass out, you stay up instead.
effect.Venom.name: Venom
effect.Venom.desc: Your weapon is coated: attack and crit chance +10%.
effect.LuckyHoney.name: Lucky Honey
effect.Planetary.name: Planetary Influence
effect.Planetary.desc: Today's planet lends you its gift.
effect.PlanetaryStrong.name: Planetary Influence
effect.PlanetaryStrong.desc: Today's planet lends you its gift, strongly.
effect.Ouroboros.name: Ouroboros
effect.Ouroboros.desc: Each kill restores a little energy.
effect.Censer.name: Smouldering Censer
effect.Censer.desc: Nearby monsters burn, and you glow.
effect.VialPendant.name: Vial Pendant
effect.VialPendant.desc: Below a quarter of your health, you drink an Elixir from your pack.
effect.RebisAmulet.name: Rebis Amulet
effect.RebisAmulet.desc: Attack by day, defence by night.
effect.Transmutation.name: Transmutation
effect.Transmutation.desc: Picked-up items sometimes come out one quality higher.
lore.Ignis.1: Cyprian's note: "Everything that burns gives some of this back."
lore.Aqua.1: Cyprian's note: "Even stone weeps a little Aqua, if you ask it right."
lore.Terra.1: Cyprian's note: "The commonest Prime, and the most patient."
lore.Sal.1: Cyprian's note: "The sea is full of it. So are tears."
lore.Sulphur.1: Cyprian's note: "Eggs, sap and anything that stinks."
lore.Mercurius.1: Cyprian's note: "It runs out of every vessel but one."
lore.Aether.1: Cyprian's note: "I have held it three times. Each time something rare was given up for it."
lore.Vitrum.1: Tobin: "Glass is just sand that's been convinced."
lore.Vitrum.10: Bennet: "Aunt Sandy says the desert sand sings when you melt it. I've never heard it. I keep listening."
lore.Vitrum.50: You can tell good Vitrum by the ring it makes. Yours rings.
lore.SalVolatile.10: Lark keeps a bottle in her pocket "for emergencies". There have been no emergencies.
lore.Elixir.1: Oriel: "Health is a balance, not a quantity. But a quantity helps."
lore.Elixir.10: The Curator watches you bottle it with something like longing.
lore.Rebis.1: The two-headed thing. It is warm on one side and cool on the other.
lore.Orichalcum.1: Agnes ran the assay three times, then sat down for a while.
lore.PrimaMateria.1: Cyprian: "I looked for it in gold for forty years. It was in the dung heap all along."
lore.LapisPhilosophorum.1: The Stone. It is smaller than you imagined, and heavier.
lore.CaputMortuum.50: The dead head. Somewhere in this pile is the start of everything.
milestone.FirstTier2: A Tier 2 compound: two substances made one.
milestone.FirstTier3: A work of the third order. Cyprian would be proud.
milestone.Kindled: The Athanor is lit, and will stay lit.
milestone.FirstSteam: Steam! Tobin will want to hear about this.
milestone.FirstLightning: Lightning in a coil. The hair on your arms stands up.
milestone.Tier1Complete: Every cell of the First Work is filled.

profession.Mechanist.name: Mechanist
profession.Mechanist.desc: Engineered apparatus work 25% faster; Boilers power one more neighbour and Coils hold one more charge.
profession.Mystic.name: Mystic
profession.Mystic.desc: Rituals use one fewer catalyst; triggering an altar sets off your other staged altars within 3 tiles.
profession.Engineer.name: Engineer
profession.Engineer.desc: Engineered apparatus reach gold quality; machine-fed ones burn 25% less fuel.
profession.Artificer.name: Artificer
profession.Artificer.desc: Minor arcane apparatus also work 25% faster; an altar beside a working Boiler may make better.
profession.Hermeticist.name: Hermeticist
profession.Hermeticist.desc: Bonus conditions on arcane work count twice; circle batches hold 25% more.
profession.Theurgist.name: Theurgist
profession.Theurgist.desc: Engineered apparatus within 2 tiles of a kindled Athanor make one step better.
unlock.Learn.name: A crafting recipe
unlock.Learn.how: Discover the substance it is made from.
building.LabT1.name: Laboratory: Still Room
building.LabT1.desc: A small alchemy laboratory. ValleyOpus apparatus inside work 10% faster, with a hearth and a dark alcove.
building.LabT2.name: Laboratory: Long Bench
building.LabT2.desc: A larger laboratory. Apparatus inside work 15% faster and sometimes better; a ritual dais fits a Circle.
building.LabT3.name: Laboratory: Great Hall
building.LabT3.desc: The great laboratory. Apparatus inside work 20% faster, and a Familiar can bond to it.

event.intro.1: Oh! You must be the farmer who opened the Community Center. I'm Oriel.#$b#I study the older kind of craft. Alchemy.
event.intro.2: There's a workshop under this building. Derelict, but not dead. A spirit keeps it.#$b#He calls himself the Curator.
event.intro.3: The door's just here, behind the Center. Come and see. I've left you a few things to start with.#$b#And if you meet a man called Tobin, he's the one who could get the machines running again.
